findings.title: Consume recovery codes in the federated test provider and test their lifecycle
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator only checks whether the submitted value is in the original list; it never removes or marks a code as used. Moreover, getCredentials() rebuilds a fresh model from that same list on every call. Consequently the same recovery code can authenticate indefinitely, the form always requests the first code, and the authenticator's exhausted-code/regeneration path is never exercised. The added integration test stops after one successful login, so it passes with this broken lifecycle. Update the test provider to persist consumption and extend the test to verify replay rejection, advancement to the next code, and regeneration after exhaustion.
